{{Dablink|For the ''[[ter'angreal]]'' in [[Far Madding]], see [[Guardian]]. For the southern body of water, see [[Sea of Storms]].}}
'''Guardian of the Sea of Storms''' is a [[title]] of the [[Altara]]n monarch. The title comes from the fact that Altara, and its capital city of [[Ebou Dar]] lay on the [[Sea of Storms]]. [[King]] [[Beslan Mitsobar]] gained this title when he gained the [[Throne of the Winds]]. His mother, [[Tylin Quintara Mitsobar]], held this title before her death.
